full_prompt_en: A square classical oil painting shows a man in dark formal clothing running toward the viewer through a smoky brown setting. The background is a broad, indistinct sweep of umber and ocher, lighter along the left and lower middle and almost black in the upper right. Rough clusters of earth and low vegetation frame the bottom corners, but no clear building or distant landmark appears. The man is placed just left of center and occupies much of the height. His wavy light-brown hair frames a serious face turned slightly to the right. He wears a black open coat whose tails flare behind him, a golden yellow waistcoat, a high white neckcloth, and pale yellow breeches above tall dark boots. One arm swings back to the left with the hand open; the other bends near his chest, its pale cuff catching light. His front leg crosses toward the lower right and the rear leg disappears into the dusky ground, giving the body a forward-driving diagonal. Thin warm highlights trace the coat opening and the creases in the waistcoat, while dark folds merge with the brown atmosphere. The face, neckcloth, hands, and front thigh are the most clearly modeled areas. Diffuse warm light enters from the left, brightening the golden garment and loose dust behind him; the right side falls into heavy shadow. Brushwork is smooth enough to define expression and dress, yet loose and smoky in the surrounding air and earth. The overall composition is urgent and theatrical, with one lit moving figure cutting through deep warm darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典油画描绘一名穿深色正式服装的男子，正从烟棕色环境中朝观者跑来。背景是宽阔而模糊的棕褐与赭黄色涂抹，左侧和下部中央较亮，右上近乎黑色。粗糙土块和低矮草木围在下方两角，却没有清楚的建筑或远方地标。男子位于中央偏左，占据大半画幅高度。波浪状浅棕发围着严肃面孔，脸略转向右侧。他穿敞开的黑外套，衣摆在身后扬起，里面是金黄色背心、高高的白色颈巾、浅黄色及膝裤和深色长靴。一条手臂向左后方摆动，手掌张开；另一条弯在胸前，浅色袖口接住光。前腿交叉伸向右下，后腿消失在昏暗地面里，使身体形成向前冲刺的斜线。细暖色高光描出外套开口和背心褶皱，深色衣折则与棕色空气融在一起。面孔、颈巾、手与前方大腿是塑形最清楚的部位。漫散暖光从左侧进入，照亮金色衣物和身后松散尘气；右侧落入厚重阴影。笔触足够平滑，能定义表情和服装，在周围空气与土地上却松动而如烟。整体构图急迫且富于舞台感，一位受光、运动中的人物切过深暖色黑暗。
style_prompt_en: The classical oil surface concentrates detailed modeling on a moving central volume and lets the surrounding field dissolve into loose warm brushwork. Burnished ocher and golden yellow emerge from deep umber, olive-black, and smoky brown, with small ivory highlights marking the brightest points. Strong diagonal gestures and trailing dark shapes give movement to an otherwise indistinct space. Edges vary from crisp around illuminated details to soft or lost where deep forms meet the background. Warm side light shapes folds and rounded planes, while the opposite side sinks quickly into shadow. Broad atmospheric strokes and rough dark accents at the lower edge keep the scene tactile without requiring precise surroundings. The composition uses a single weighted center against a large shadow field. The overall effect is energetic, dramatic, and historical, with chiaroscuro carrying the sense of urgency.
style_prompt_zh: 古典油画表面把细致塑形集中在运动的中央体量上，让周围色域消融成松动的暖色笔触。磨亮赭色与金黄色从深棕褐、橄榄黑和烟棕色中浮现，少量象牙白高光标记最亮处。强烈斜向姿态和拖曳的深色形体赋予原本模糊的空间运动感。受光细节周围的边缘清晰，深色形体与背景相遇处则柔和甚至消失。暖色侧光塑造褶面和圆润平面，另一侧很快沉入阴影。宽阔空气感笔触和下缘粗糙深色重音让场景保有触感，无需精确描绘周围环境。构图以一个有重量的中心对照大片阴影区域。整体效果活跃、戏剧化而带历史气息，明暗对照承载急迫感。
theme_en: A man in dark coat and yellow waistcoat running through smoky brown ground
theme_zh: 身穿深外套和黄背心的男子跑过烟棕色地面
name: John Trumbull
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
